keep_playing_why: B gave me a skill to master: read the gauge, charge the lance under a storm cell, go airborne, couch late. Each new rival (Volta, Brisa, Kite) changed the rules, so I kept finding a better line, and the victory cards with badges and scores paid it off. In A I took two minutes to learn what scored, the combo stayed at x1 most of the run, and a lot of time went to crash recovery with no score.
better_made_why: B teaches itself with short on-screen hints at the moment they matter, has a clear versus screen, result card, rival progression and strong hit feedback. A looks gorgeous at night in the rain and the drift pop-ups and vibration are punchy, but its scoring is unexplained and the off-road magnet wipeout wastes 5 to 8 s. B's flaws are dead sailing time after each pass and a tight timing window that is hard on coarse input.
furthest_A: Score 8691, combo x2 peak (x1 most of the run), 45 mi driven, in-game clock 01:49 (dusk to rain to night to past midnight), through a tunnel and past a torii gate section; about 12 crashes and magnet recoveries.
furthest_B: Beat 3 rivals in a row (Bosun Barnacle, Doc Volta, Contessa Brisa), best victory score 2,350; lost to the 4th rival, Kite Kowalski, at Tilt 10 around 540 s. Lost the first 4 Barnacle matches before learning the timing.
